## Summary

Ran **only** the planning pipeline via `/plan --amends #1 --yes` — no delivery, no pre-staged artifacts.

**Story #3 — "Share projects with other users via viewer/editor roles"** ([issue #3](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-epic-scope-mandrel-d9e05d60/issues/3), `agent::ready`, `plan-run::feec7d59`)

Authored from the **delta envelope** for #1 (its prior body, acceptance, and delivered file map) rather than a from-scratch re-interrogation. One cohesive Story (default-single), since sharing spans the shares table, the role-aware access gate, and the share endpoint — all reading one access model.

**What it specifies:**
- **Schema (Unit 1):** new append-only migration adding `project_shares(project_id, user_id, role)` — role ∈ {viewer, editor}, cascading FKs, unique per (project, user).
- **Access model (load-bearing):** replaces the single owner-only gate (`requireOwnedProject`) with an ordered-level helper — `none < viewer < editor < owner` — that throws the **same 404** as today when the caller has no relationship, so privacy is never weakened. Per-endpoint minimums: viewer for project/task reads, editor for task writes, owner for delete/share/exports.
- **`POST /projects/:id/shares` `{userId, role}`:** owner-only, idempotent, with 4xx (not 5xx) on unknown user or bad/missing role.
- **Non-goals** fence off the worker, admin CLI, exports access, and revoke — keeping the change confined to the API unit and the store schema.

**Pipeline gates:** critics all skipped (single small Story, text-hygiene clean); dry-run passed every validator; the lone spec-word-budget advisory was resolved by tightening the Spec to contract altitude. Both HITL gates auto-proceeded under `--yes`.

Deliver later with `/deliver 3`. Note: `--amends` is a plan-context-only concept — persist creates a **new** Story (#3) that amends #1; it does not edit #1, and #1 stays as the shipped baseline.

Delivered. Story #3 landed — PR #4 merged to `main`, `agent::done`.

## Outcome

The planning pipeline had opened **one** open ticket for this task — Story **#3** *"Share projects with other users via viewer/editor roles"* (`type::story`, `plan-run::feec7d59`). Under the v2 Story-only model there is no `type::epic` label; this single Story is the epic-scope deliverable. I delivered the existing plan unchanged.

**Terminal envelope:** `status: landed`, PR [#4](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-epic-scope-mandrel-d9e05d60/pull/4) **MERGED**, checks `success`, gates `validation/baseSync/codeReview: passed`. Code review ran 3 lenses at light depth → **0 findings**. The only degradation is `baseFastForward: false` (main checkout dirty from the pre-existing `.worktrees/`), which degrades the report only — the merge stands.

**What shipped (confined to the API unit + store schema, per the Spec):**
- `src/store/migrations/002_shares.js` — append-only migration adding `project_shares(project_id, user_id, role)`: role `CHECK IN ('viewer','editor')`, both ids FK with `ON DELETE CASCADE`, composite PK enforcing one role per user per project. `npm run migrate` idempotent (exit 0 twice).
- `src/api/projects.js` — replaced the owner-only check with an ordered access model (`none < viewer < editor < owner`) via `requireProjectAccess`; `listProjects` now UNIONs owned + shared.
- `src/api/shares.js` (new) — `POST /projects/:id/shares`, owner-only, idempotent upsert; unknown user / bad or missing role → 4xx JSON, never 5xx.
- `src/api/tasks.js` — reads gate at viewer, mutations at editor.
- `src/api/server.js` — wired the shares route.
- `tests/shares/shares.test.js` (new) — 8 contract tests across AC-2…AC-8.

**The privacy split (a judgment the AC forced):** the gate returns **404** to a caller with *no* relationship (never reveals existence — AC-7) but **403** to a caller who can see the project yet lacks the required level (e.g. a viewer's task mutation — AC-5). Exports stayed owner-only (worker and admin CLI untouched).

**Verification:** full `npm test` = **34 pass / 0 fail**, confirming the pre-existing worker e2e and admin suites still pass (AC-9). A fresh maker-blind acceptance-critic scored all 9 criteria `met`; the gate returned `decision: proceed`.
